scope: Sources used or discovered in the opening analytic RH-to-simplicity round and subsequent strategic comparison; not a repository-wide bibliography backfill.
availability_policy: Consult the root-generated download/hash manifest for verified local availability, source URL, byte count and SHA-256. No PDFs belong in this Git catalog.

sources.title: A proof of Newman's conjecture for the extended Selberg class
sources.role: Prior-art comparison for complete heat-deformed Dirichlet series and the gamma carrier; Newman nonnegativity in the extended Selberg class.
sources.limitation: Its fixed-negative-time results must not be silently treated as the uniform shrinking-time Euler-region estimate proved in this round. Match normalization and parameters before transferring a statement; no simplicity theorem is imported.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata and PDF introduction/formulas checked on 2026-10-23; detailed theorem match is owned by the associated research/review note.

sources.title: The De Bruijn-Newman constant is non-negative
sources.role: Established Newman lower bound and complete real-root dynamics background for the positive-time route.
sources.limitation: The conclusion Lambda>=0 does not imply simple zeros at time zero. Root-motion identities require the paper's regularity, completeness and time-domain conditions; a local cluster argument cannot discard exterior forces.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned bibliographic metadata and abstract checked on 2026-10-23; this catalog is not a fresh audit of the complete proof.

sources.title: On Montgomery's pair correlation conjecture: a tale of three integrals
sources.role: Lemma 16 and Theorem 5 supply the shifted logarithmic-derivative/Poisson comparison; Section 1.2 records pair-correlation equivalences.
sources.limitation: The imported upper bound optimizes to the 4/3 multiplicity-moment bound in this round's calculation. The conjectural asymptotic is not an RH-only estimate; cumulative upper bounds cannot be subtracted to assert the same local constant.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata, Lemma 16, Theorem 5, and Section 1.2 (IV) checked in full text on 2026-10-23; independent optimization is in the comparison note.

sources.title: Mean values of the logarithmic derivative of the Riemann zeta-function near the critical line
sources.role: Comparison of higher logarithmic-derivative moments with a multiplicity-sensitive small-gap hypothesis.
sources.limitation: Theorem 1.1 assumes RH plus ES(2K). That hypothesis counts distinct labels in microscopic tuples, so repeated zeros contribute already; importing the moments as RH-only simplicity information would be circular.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata, Theorem 1.1 and the displayed definition of ES(2K) checked in full text on 2026-10-23.

sources.title: On simple zeros of the Riemann zeta-function
sources.role: RH-conditional 19/27 benchmark for the proportion of simple zeros.
sources.limitation: This is an asymptotic proportion, not every-zero simplicity, and is not a consequence supplied by the present heat estimates. No exhaustive up-to-date priority claim is made by citing it.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata; Section 2 Cauchy bound, mollifier class, Lemma 2 error bound and final first/second moment formulas, plus Section 3.1 squarefree support reduction checked on 2026-10-23. Full proof not freshly audited.

sources.title: Pair Correlation Estimates for the Zeros of the Zeta Function via Semidefinite Programming
sources.role: RH multiplicity moment N*(T)<=(1.3208+o(1))N(T), used in the hybrid heat/moment consumer.
sources.limitation: N* sums m over repeated labels and therefore equals the sum of m^2 over distinct zeros. The resulting C<=0.3208N is cumulative; subtracting cumulative upper bounds does not localize its constant.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata and full-text counting convention checked on 2026-10-23; Theorem 1 numerical constant was previously checked in Note 10.

sources.title: A new proof that more than 2/3 of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are simple and on the critical line
sources.role: Recent benchmark/context check and an alternative Hilbert-space simplicity argument.
sources.limitation: Its unconditional simple-critical-line proportions must not be conflated with the stronger RH-conditional 19/27 comparison. This catalog does not verify the entire proof, formal certificate, or priority narrative.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata, abstract and introductory counting convention checked on 2026-10-23; RH benchmark context was checked in Note 10.

sources.title: Effective approximation of heat flow evolution of the Riemann xi function, and a new upper bound for the de Bruijn-Newman constant
sources.role: Canonical H0=xi/8 normalization, effective positive-time heat approximations, and fixed-positive-time high-height zero asymptotics.
sources.limitation: The computational bound Lambda<=0.22 is not RH. A theorem for each fixed positive time need not be uniform as time tends to zero; retain all approximation errors and the stated height cutoff.
sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata and full-text normalization/introductory theorem statements checked on 2026-10-23; detailed approximation imports remain subject to their cited research notes.

sources.title: On a mollifier of the perturbed Riemann zeta-function
sources.role: Prior-art lead for Feng-type arithmetic mollifier coefficients.

sources.verification_scope: Version-pinned metadata and abstract checked on 2026-10-23; full proof not read.

sources.title: More than five-twelfths of the zeros of ζ are on the critical line
sources.role: Prior art for prime-factor/convolution mollifiers; squarefree support warning for the proposed discrete derivative-moment comparison.
sources.limitation: Continuous twisted second moments cannot be imported as discrete moments at zeta zeros. Preserve squarefree restriction; do not identify restricted coefficients with an unrestricted convolution or assume omitted terms are lower order.
sources.verification_scope: Publisher HTML Section 3.2, equations (3.3)-(3.4), and opening discussion of Section 5 checked on 2026-10-23. arXiv v3 metadata checked and PDF retained, but no equivalence audit of published and preprint versions or full proof review.

sources.title: A discrete mean value of the Riemann zeta function
sources.role: Corrected general first shifted discrete moment; first derivative specializes to the Feng-direction first moment.
sources.verification_scope: Checked Theorem 1.1 (9), explicit kernel (10)-(11), coefficient conditions (4)-(8), post-(11) correction remark, and m=1 formula (27); PDF and HTML.
sources.limitation: Needs fixed theta<1/2 plus submultiplicative/divisor-bounded coefficient sequences. Standalone prime-vanishing Feng direction fails that hypothesis; use the proved affine perturbation family. The authors explicitly correct Ng's older main term and large-sieve error; do not use Ng Theorem 1.3 literally.

sources.title: Lower bounds for discrete negative moments of the Riemann zeta function
sources.role: Theorem 2 supplies a general unconditional shifted discrete second moment, allowing derivative-square and cross moments by shift differentiation and polarization.
sources.verification_scope: Checked Theorem 2 pp3-4, equations (5)-(9), unconditional remark, Section 4 contour identity, Section 4.4/Propositions 7-8 and Cauchy differentiation discussion. Conjugation checked in HTML.
sources.limitation: Theorem 1 assumes simplicity, but Theorem 2 explicitly does not; the contour residue counts multiplicities. Fixed theta<1/2 and submultiplicativity/divisor bounds remain essential. Main term contains all three Z terms plus J; no diagonal-only truncation is justified.

sources.title: A discrete mean value of the derivative of the Riemann zeta function
sources.role: Historical predecessor and correction provenance for discrete derivative mean values.
sources.verification_scope: Checked coefficient conditions (2)-(3) and Theorem 1.3; compared with the explicit correction remark in Benli-Elma-Ng 2311.13554v1.
sources.limitation: Do not import the displayed old main term/error unchanged. Benli-Elma-Ng identifies and repairs errors. This entry is retained as superseded-for-import provenance, not an additional valid arithmetic input.

sources.title: On optimality of mollifiers
sources.role: Abstract first/cross/second moment optimality criterion; direct provenance for residual correlation test and finite-span projection principle.
sources.verification_scope: Pinned HTML and PDF checked: Section 2 definitions, Theorems 2.4 and 2.5, Corollaries 2.6 and 2.7, Remark 2.11; proof of Theorem 2.4 in Section 3 (PDF p. 15). Theorems 1.1 and 1.3 concern different arithmetic families; no imported zeta derivative Feng identity or general 19/27 ceiling.
sources.limitation: General projection/optimality framework, with different arithmetic applications; supplies no discrete Feng cross identity or universal 19/27 ceiling. Null leading norms need lower-order analysis.

sources.title: Simple zeros of the Riemann zeta-function

sources.role: Historical quadratic-profile optimization for discrete zeta derivative mollification.

sources.limitation: Historical GLH-dependent ordinary mu P result, not the modern error import and not optimality over enriched arithmetic coefficients.
